_comment: The identity of each fixture's failure, not merely that one occurred. BD's harness printed '12 fired, 0 did NOT' while 7 of the 12 were TypeError from its own wrong call signatures -- a checker passing for the wrong reason, inside the script written to find checkers that pass for the wrong reason. This file closes the same hole here one level finer: --selftest already required the right RULE, and a rule with four branches (R6) could have drifted to the wrong branch and still passed. Each value is a substring that must appear in the matching error.
r7-machine-confirmed.json: reserve this field for a human
r10-class-better-than-worst: is better than the worst entry
r11-drifted-copy: so the later ones are copies
